about: Electra Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the contracting, construction, infrastructure, and electromechanical system businesses in Israel and internationally. It offers electrical infrastructure products for high voltage, medium/high voltage, and low voltage supplies for buildings, industries, and infrastructure projects.
